subtitle: Bigger isn't simply better — it's a cost you choose to pay

code:
384 dims  -> 1,536 bytes  (~1.5 KB)
1536 dims -> 6,144 bytes  (~6 KB)
3072 dims -> 12,288 bytes (~12 KB)

# 1M chunks @ 1536 dims
# = 6.1 GB of raw vectors alone
caption: Small per vector — large once multiplied across a real collection.

code:
full_vector = embed(text)  # 3072 dims

# MRL-trained model: truncate and
# still get a usable embedding
smaller = full_vector[:512]

# No re-embedding required
caption: A quality/cost dial, instead of being locked into one fixed size.
